subject: Important Update Regarding Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We wanted to inform you that there has been a change to your upcoming flight reservation. Due to unforeseen circumstances, the departure time for your flight has been shifted by 2 hours. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Best regards, [Airline Name]
